seoTitle: Draw a Straight Line on a TradingView Chart
metaDescription: Learn how to use the trend line tool in TradingView to draw, customize, and remove straight lines for spotting trends and key levels.
intro: Drawing straight lines on a TradingView chart helps highlight trends, support and resistance levels, and other key points in your analysis. This guide covers finding the trend line tool, drawing a line, and customizing or removing it afterward.

steps.heading: Open a chart
steps.body: Log into TradingView and open the chart you want to draw on, choosing a layout that suits your analysis.

steps.heading: Select the trend line tool
steps.body: Find the trend line tool in the left-side toolbar, usually shown as a diagonal line or arrow icon.

steps.heading: Draw the line
steps.body: Click your starting point on the chart, drag to your desired endpoint, and release to place the line.

steps.heading: Customize the line's color
steps.body: Right-click the line and open its settings to choose a color that stands out on your chart.

steps.heading: Adjust the line's thickness
steps.body: Set a bolder line for significant trends or a thinner one to keep the chart uncluttered.

steps.heading: Remove the line if needed
steps.body: Click the line to select it and press delete, or right-click and choose remove to take it off the chart.

faq.question: How do I draw a straight line on TradingView?
faq.answer: Select the trend line tool from the left toolbar, then click and drag from your starting point to your endpoint.

faq.question: Can I change the color of a line after drawing it?
faq.answer: Yes, right-click the line and open its settings to adjust color and thickness.

faq.question: How do I delete a line I drew?
faq.answer: Click the line to select it and press delete, or right-click and choose the remove option.

faq.question: What is the trend line tool used for?
faq.answer: It's commonly used to highlight market trends, support and resistance levels, or other key points in your analysis.

faq.question: Can I adjust line thickness for emphasis?
faq.answer: Yes, you can make lines bolder to highlight significant trends or thinner to keep the chart clean.
